Rowan Fitzgerald Auctioneers are delighted to present this beautifully renovated three-bedroom semi-detached home in the highly sought-after Greenfields, Rossbrien, Limerick. Having just undergone substantial renovations throughout, this impressive property comes to the rental market in pristine, turn-key condition, offering a superb opportunity for tenants seeking a stylish and exceptionally comfortable home.

Substantial works have been completed bringing this property to life, with new flooring, a newly fitted kitchen, brand-new appliances and new furniture throughout. Upon entering, you are greeted by a bright and spacious entrance hallway, setting the tone for the generous accommodation throughout. The large living room is warm and inviting, featuring attractive new laminate flooring and providing an ideal space for relaxing or entertaining.

To the rear, the open-plan kitchen and dining area creates a wonderful heart to the home. Bright and spacious, this modern living space enjoys a pleasant outlook over the rear garden. The newly fitted kitchen is both stylish and practical, incorporating all modern conveniences and brand-new appliances, with ample storage and preparation space.

Upstairs, the property boasts three generously proportioned double bedrooms, each benefiting from excellent built-in wardrobe storage. The accommodation is completed by a beautifully appointed, newly fitted bathroom, featuring a modern finish. The property also boosts a combi boiler which means hot water on demand.For additional convenience, there is also a separate guest WC with wash hand basin.

Externally, the property continues to impress. The front garden provides private off-street parking, while to the rear is a spacious private garden with a patio area, offering an ideal setting.

Property Highlights
•	Three spacious double bedrooms
•	Newly renovated throughout
•	Pristine, turn-key condition
•	Brand-new furniture throughout
•	Newly fitted modern kitchen
•	Brand-new kitchen appliances
•	Bright open-plan kitchen/dining area
•	Large living room with new laminate flooring
•	Modern newly fitted bathroom
•	Combi Boiler- Hot water on demand. 
•	Separate downstairs WC
•	Excellent built-in wardrobe storage
•	Private off-street parking
•	Impressive C3 BER Rating
•	Spacious rear garden with patio area
•	Highly desirable Greenfields location

Location & Local Amenities: 

Situated in the established residential area of Greenfields, Rossbrien, this property enjoys a convenient south-western Limerick location with easy access to Limerick city centre and surrounding areas. The property is well served by public transport, with local bus stop close to Greenfields, providing excellent local connections to the City Centre and surrounding areas. The nearby Rossbrien Interchange and Limerick Southern Ring Road provide excellent access to the wider road network, including routes towards Cork, Galway and Shannon.

The area offers a wide range of local amenities, with schools, shops, supermarkets, cafés and everyday services all within easy reach. Residents can enjoy nearby parks, green spaces and a variety of sports and recreational facilities, while  The Crescent Shopping Centre provides excellent options for shopping and leisure. Limerick city centre is also conveniently accessible, offering an extensive choice of restaurants, cafés, cultural attractions and entertainment. The property also benefits from its close proximity the University Hospital Limerick, Mary Immaculate College, Raheen Business Park, Colbert Train Station and Limerick City Centre.
